name: reschedule-happy-path
pins: A reschedule moves an appointment; it never creates a second one and never cancels the first. The plan is `reschedule` plus `follow_up` - the department and the required documents were settled when it was booked, so neither is re-derived, but the reminder moves with the appointment and there is something to summarise. `appointments_created: 0` alongside a still-confirmed row is the pair that says 'moved' rather than 'replaced'.

turns.message: please reschedule my appointment to next week
